mechanismNote: Inline mechanism per D203/D204. First set of rulings for the PhDRepsWebsite project, raised 2026-09-11 when the design was downloaded from Claude Design and the end-of-turn record check fired with nothing to write.
readback: D1 answered by bare option number, so no D282 read-back was required.

D1.question: This folder is a website rather than computational research, so the end-of-turn record check has no LOG.jsonl or STAGE.yaml to write and will keep firing. Should a .claude-no-record marker file be added at the project root to silence it for good?
D1.label: Add it

options.label: Add it
options.text: Write a .claude-no-record file at the project root, which tells the research-log-reminder hook that this project will never keep a research record.
options.for: The check cannot be satisfied here, so every turn in this repo would otherwise end on a reminder that has nothing to act on, and a reminder that always fires is one that stops being read.
options.against: It is a permanent opt-out: if the project ever did grow a research component, the silence would be inherited and nobody would notice the check was gone.

options.label: Leave it, and live with the reminder
options.text: Add nothing, and let the record check fire at the end of every turn in this project.
options.for: Nothing is silenced, so a genuinely gated choice in this repo still meets a prompt asking for it to be recorded.
options.against: The noise falls on every turn regardless of whether anything happened, which is the pattern that trains a reminder to be ignored.
